description: Parse ATM Electronic Journal log lines for NCR and GRG vendors into structured fields. Loaded into OpenSearch and referenced by filebeat.yml (output.elasticsearch.pipeline).

patterns: %{TIMESTAMP_ISO8601:event_time} \| %{DATA:atm_id} \| %{DATA:terminal_id} \| %{DATA:event_type} \| %{DATA:sub_type} \| SEQ=%{DATA:seq} \| CARD=%{DATA:card_masked} \| AMOUNT=%{NUMBER:amount} \| CURRENCY=%{DATA:currency} \| STATUS=%{DATA:status}(\| AUTH=%{DATA:auth_code})?
